title: Calibration v1 — the premises every other rule derives from
description: Validates policy/calibration.v1.yaml. This file states the learner premise, the pedagogy caps that follow from it, and the safety floor. It outranks every prose document in the project. The permitted power inputs are NOT here: they belong to one kit rather than to the engine, and they live in that curriculum's own kit calibration, validated by kit_calibration.schema.v1.json. The caps here are premises, not preferences: each names the schema constraint that implements it in enforced_by, and the anchored prose_pattern that matches it as prose would write it, so a gate can find an unowned copy without scanning bare values.

learner.description: The premise. Every value in pedagogy_caps is derived from age_band.

age_band.description: Minimum age with a plus, e.g. '9+'. One band per calibration file — a workbook written for two ages at once is written for neither.

pedagogy_caps.description: Derived from learner.age_band. Never edit a value here independently of the age band - change the band, then re-derive and justify each cap. Every cap carries its value, the schema constraint that enforces it, and the prose pattern that finds an unowned copy of it.

value.description: Working-memory limit for the band. Above 6 is not a calibration, it is a glossary.

enforced_by.description: A path of the form '<file> → <json pointer or dotted path>'.

prose_pattern.description: An anchored regular expression matching this cap as it would be written in prose. Required: a cap with no pattern fails FR-P3-CAPS-OWNED rather than being skipped, because scanning the bare value would flag every ordinal and list index in the repository.

learner_terms.description: Every fact in this file that describes this learner rather than any learner, with the anchored pattern that matches it in prose. FR-P3-NO-LITERALS reads this list and matches the pattern, never the bare value, so a contract cannot hard-code the learner (F03).

schema.description: The contract this manifest is validated against. FR-P4-ALL-VALIDATE resolves the pairing from here rather than from a list held in the gate.
